'''''Tiyula itum''''' ([[English language|English]]: "black soup") is a [[Filipino cuisine|Filipino]] [[braised]] [[beef]] or [[goat meat|goat]] [[soup]] or [[stew]] originating from the [[Tausug people]]. The dish is characteristically black due to the unique use of charred [[coconut]] meat.
